text:
ana: Kicking off a joint perf/W bench with OrionEdge. Need to align on runs, kernel tweaks, telemetry contract, and publication timing. Who's in? cc @eva_hw

sam_engineer: I'm in. Suggest we test 3 models (redwood-lite-7b, vicuna-13b, mixtral-8x) across seq {8,16,64} and batch sizes {1,2,4}. Measure tokens/s, p95 latency, energy/seq and thermals.

eva_hw: OrionEdge can ship 6 boards (liquid-cooled) + vendor FW. We can provide hw sensors (per-fan, per-die) and a minimal admin image. Timeline: dry-run two weeks before main. Need cross-account storage for telemetry.

raj: From infra: prefer Orion host the S3 bucket and give us a cross-account role. Telemetry format: newline-delimited JSON + gzipped perf tar for each run. We'll validate against schema.

zhen: Kernel owner here. Orion kernel needs two small patches: 1) stable powercap sysfs mapping; 2) rmm patch for KV cache pinning. We should do patch PRs to reproduce. Also request perf record with -F 99 and kernel traces.

ana: @eva_hw can Orion accept us flashing a test kernel? If not, we can run a user-space shim. Also agree on embargo window: 5 business days post-run for partner review.

eva_hw: Orion can allow signed kernel images only. Workaround: we run patched modules against vendor kernel in our lab (they'll enable module signing for the test hash). We'll share baseline idle/load watt numbers. 5-day embargo ok.

sam_engineer: Quick orchestration sketch:
```yaml
jobs:
  - model: redwood-lite-7b
    seqs: [8,16,64]
    batches: [1,2,4]
  - model: vicuna-13b
    seqs: [8,16,64]
    batches: [1,2]
metrics: [tokens_per_sec, p95_latency_ms, energy_per_token_mj, max_die_temp_c]
```

zhen: For tuning cadence: dry-run -> gather traces -> 3 business days dev triage -> patch window 48h -> 2-day regression sweep. Need serial console and the jumpbox.

raj: Logging/telemetry fields we need: run_id, timestamp, board_serial, model, seq_len, batch_size, tokens_per_sec, p95_latency_ms, energy_per_token_mj, max_die_temp_c, kernel_tag, fw_version, notes. Keep field names stable.

eva_hw: We'll provide board_serial mapping and per-board thermal calibration data. We'll also provide fan curves and typical ambient numbers.

sam_engineer: Also plan to run turbo-on vs turbo-off and frequency-limited runs to show thermal headroom. We'll include a normalized perf/W metric (tokens/sec per watt) and an adjusted metric using Orion's baseline.

ana: Action items:
- sam_engineer: own run orchestration + CI job templates (deliver by EOW)
- zhen: prepare patch PRs and module build instructions
- raj: set up telemetry validator + intake role policy
- eva_hw: ship boards, provide FW, sensor schema, and baseline numbers
- ana: partner comms, embargo, and announcement draft

perfbot: Reminder: dry-run kickoff scheduled 2026-02-02 10:00 PT (ticket INF-5981 auto-created).

eva_hw: Confirmed dates. We'll aim to have IAM and images by next Tuesday. One ask: can you include a short reproducibility checklist (serial console steps, kernel flash steps) in the runbook?

sam_engineer: Yes, will add a reproducibility section + sample commands (serial, nvme power cap, perf record flags). Example: `perf record -a -F99 -g -- sleep 60` and `echo 150 > /sys/class/drm/card0/device/power_dpm_force_performance_level`.

zhen: Note: that last command is vendor-specific, include fallbacks. Also document how we collect NVMe and PCIe power readings.

ana: I'll draft the partner runbook and post link here by Thursday. Thanks all. :v:

eva_hw: Thanks team, excited to collaborate. :handshake:
